standardization: RDKit Cleanup, FragmentParent(skipStandardize=True), Uncharger; retain original views alongside the neutral principal fragment. No tautomer canonicalization or assay lookup.
selection: Inherited v40 full-v39 valid shortlist freeze then 3 scaffold folds; objective 0.45 valid +0.55 CV mean -0.04 CV SD; valid gain>0.0002, CV mean>0, objective>0.0005. Individual folds allowed to decline.
limitations: Reused historical valid and folds; CV is proxy. Other-task supplied assays conditional. Parent features might change pH/salt interpretation; final selections remain validation-based. No official score guarantee.
